# Psalm 75 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. Do-not-destroy. A-psalm of-Asaph. A-song. We-give-thanks to-you O-God, we-give-thanks, and-near your-name; they-recount your-wondrous-deeds.

**2** When I-take the-appointed-time, I with-equity will-judge.

**3** Are-dissolving the-earth and-all its-inhabitants; I have-set-firm its-pillars. Selah.

**4** I-said to-the-boasters, 'Do-not boast,' and-to-the-wicked, 'Do-not lift-up the-horn.'

**5** Do-not lift to-the-height your-horn; do-not speak with-neck stiff.

**6** For not from-east and-not from-west, and-not from-wilderness exaltation.

**7** For God is-judge; this-one he-brings-low and-this-one he-lifts-up.

**8** For a-cup in-hand-of YHWH, and-wine foams, full-of mixture, and-he-pours from-this; surely its-dregs they-drain they-drink, all the-wicked-of the-earth.

**9** And-I will-declare to-forever; I-will-sing-praises to-God-of Jacob.

**10** And-all horns-of the-wicked I-will-cut-off; will-be-lifted-up the-horns-of the-righteous.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **75:2-5**: Direct divine speech in the psalm — YHWH himself speaks as cosmic judge; rare in the Psalter.

- **75:8**: The 'cup' of YHWH — yayin chamer ('wine foams') with mesekh ('mixture/spice') — an image of divine wrath poured out for the wicked.

— EMET
